selection_type: post hoc illustrative favorable cases, not an unbiased estimate of accuracy
eligible: held-out multi-mutants with quantitative labels in the three original PDB complexes
rationale: retain original biological systems; illustrate near-neutral, strong, and moderate changes; include light, heavy, and antigen sites; choose interpretable cases with modest observed errors
strict_followup_rule: use these same rows for every declared strict seed, regardless of resulting errors
plus8_policy: retain all records for original benchmark; additionally exclude assigned +8.00 nonbinder labels for quantitative sensitivity analysis and figure case eligibility
